entries.source: Urkundenbuch des Cistercienserstiftes B. Mariae V. zu Hohenfurt in Böhmen, Nr. CLXIX. , S. 213, CLXIX.
entries.german:
1387. 15. August. 0. A0. — Johann von Rosenberg, Borscho, Archidiacon von Bechin und Hostislaus, Pfarrer in Krumau und Dechant in Teindles, schlichten den zwischen dem Abte Otto und Convente von Hohenfurt einerseits und dem Pfarrer Pfibiko von Priethal andererseits wegen des Priethaler Laienzehenis obschwebenden Streit.

CLXIX. In nomine domini amen. Nos Johannes de Rozmberg Borsso Bechinensis archidiaconus diocesis Pragensis necnon Hostislaus ple- banus ecclesie in Chrumpnaw decanusque Dublensis*) ad perpetuam rei memoriam. Coram vninersis tam presentibus quam futuris pre- sencium tenore volumus publice declarare protestantes, quod super et in dissensionibus litibus et materiarum querelis inter honorabiles et religiosos viros videlicet dominum Ottonem abhatem et conuentum monasterii in Alionado parte vna et discretum virum dominum Przy- bykonem plebanum in Przyedol pro decimarum laycalium solucione ibidem in Przyedol parte vertentibus ex altera ad ipsarum instantiuas preces partium arbitri judices et amicabiles compositores assumpti et vnanimiter electi animo deliberato et discretorum consiliis pre- cedentibus freti perswasiuis pronunciamus diffinimus arbitramur per prefatas partes perpetue tenendum et eorum quoslibet successores babendum et possidendum, presentibus diffinitiue sentenciamus ac effectiue ordinamus, quod prescripti domini videlicet dominus Otto abbas et conuentus monasterii, prout prescribebantur, super decem et octo laneis decimum capete tritici siliginis ordei et auene in cam- pis ab incolis et rusticis predictorum laneorum, ipse vero dominus Przybyco, prout eciam prius nominatus, aut sui perpetui circa ipsam ecclesiam successores de antedictis decem et octo laneis et eorum incolis non plus nisi vnam tinam siliginis et vnarn tinam auene in grano triturato pro decimis debeant recipere et colligere pro suis *) Soll belesen „DuJlebeniis*. 200 vsibus singulis annis qualicumque jure et conswetudine in contrarium non obstante. Ego vero pren ominatus Przybyko plebanus ecclesie in Przyedol matura mentis deliberaci one et consiliis amicorum salu- bribus premissis antedictam pronuncciacionem vna cum meis futuris ecclesie successoribus tamquam condignam et laudabilem recipio assumo et presentibus approbo piomittens fide sincera et sine cuius- libet fraudis scrupulo, eandem disposicionem et ordinacionem per me et meos successores perpetuis temponbus teuere ratam et firmam fideliter obseruare. In cuius rei robur perpetue valiturum sigillo meo et in maius testimonium sigillis meorum premissorum judicum et arbitrorum presencia iussimus de nostra certa sciencia roborare. Datum et actum anno ab incarnacione domini millesimo trecentesimo octuagesimo septimo infra octauas assumpcionis virginis gloriose. Vier an Pergamentstreifen hängende Siegel, a) und Ь) in rothem, c) und d) in weissem Wachs. a) Das bekannte Siegel Johann's von Rosenberg. b) Mit tel gross. Eine Frauengestalt mit Heiligenschein und einem Lamm (?) zur Linken. — * S . Borsonis . Archidiaconi . Bechienss. c) Ein Kopf mit Hei ligenschein. — S. Hostislay (i?) . . . (schlecht abgedruckt). d) Ein Rost (St. Laurenz ist Patron der Priethaler Kirche). — S . Przybisslay . Plebani. De. Priedol.
entries.english:
1387, 15 August. Hans von Rosenberg, Borscho, archdeacon of Bechin, and Hostislaus, parish priest of Krumau and dean of Teindles, settle the dispute over the lay tithe of Priethal between Abbot Otto and the convent of Hohenfurt on one side and Pfibiko, parish priest of Priethal, on the other.

CLXIX. In the name of the Lord, amen. We, Hans von Rosenberg and Borsso, archdeacon of Bechin in the diocese of Prague, and Hostislaus, parish priest of Krumau and dean of Dublen, for perpetual remembrance, publicly declare to all present and future that, having been appointed and unanimously chosen as arbitrators, judges, and amicable composers at the parties’ urgent request, after deliberation and counsel from prudent men, we decide and order as follows in the dispute between the honorable and religious Lord Otto, abbot, and the convent of Hohenfurt Monastery on one side, and the discreet Lord Przybyko, parish priest of Priethal, on the other, concerning payment of lay tithes at Priethal. The aforesaid abbot and convent shall receive, for their use each year, a tenth part of the wheat, rye, barley, and oats in the fields from the inhabitants and tenants of the eighteen hides. Lord Przybyko, or his perpetual successors at that church, shall receive and collect from the same eighteen hides and their inhabitants no more than one bushel of threshed rye and one bushel of threshed oats as grain tithes. This award is definitively pronounced and effectively ordered for the parties and each of their successors to keep and hold forever, notwithstanding any contrary right or custom.

I, the aforesaid Przybyko, parish priest of Priethal, after mature deliberation and sound advice from friends, accept and approve this ruling as proper and praiseworthy, together with my future successors at the church, and faithfully promise in good faith and without deceit to keep and observe this arrangement firmly forever. In lasting confirmation, we have ordered this document to be strengthened by my seal and, as further testimony, by the seals of the aforesaid judges and arbitrators, with our certain knowledge. Given and done in the year of the Lord 1387, within the octave of the glorious Virgin’s Assumption.

Four seals hang from parchment strips: a and b in red wax, c and d in white wax. (a) The known seal of Hans von Rosenberg. (b) Medium-sized, a woman with halo and perhaps a lamb at her left; inscription: seal of Borsso, archdeacon of Bechin. (c) A haloed head; the poorly printed inscription appears to read Hostislaus. (d) A gridiron, Saint Lawrence being patron of the Priethal church; seal of Przybisslay, parish priest of Priethal.
